name: WiC
description: Word-in-Context (WiC) is a binary classification task for evaluating word sense disambiguation in context. Given two sentences and a target word appearing in both, models determine whether the word has the same meaning in both contexts. Tests fine-grained lexical semantic understanding.
reputation: Component of SuperGLUE; tests fine-grained word sense disambiguation; human performance ~80%; models have struggled to match human performance
notes: Introduced at NAACL 2019. Part of SuperGLUE benchmark. Contains 7,466 pairs (5,428 train, 638 dev, 1,400 test). Target words span nouns, verbs, and adjectives drawn from WordNet and VerbNet. Challenging because same-word comparisons require deep semantic understanding beyond surface features.
